result.title: FragFlex: Fragment-Based Flexible Molecular Generation for Exploring Vast Chemical Space
result.comment: 15 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on AI for Drug Discovery: Bridging the Translation Gap
result.summary: Drug discovery requires efficient exploration of an astronomically large chemical space. Molecular graph diffusion models offer a promising approach to this task, but many require graph size to be fixed before generation. Although atom-level insertion and deletion can enable flexible-size generation, jointly modeling molecular size, atom types, and bonds while maintaining chemical validity remains challenging. We introduce FragFlex, a flexible-length discrete diffusion model that performs node insertion and deletion at the fragment level. During denoising, FragFlex jointly learns the size, fragment identities, and inter-fragment connectivity of the fragment graph. A neural attachment-site predictor and valence-aware assembler then convert the generated fragment graph into an atom-level molecule. In large-scale experiments generating 10 million molecules, FragFlex achieves near-perfect chemical validity while maintaining high uniqueness, demonstrating a strong balance between the two.

AI.brief_summary: FragFlex 提出片段级可变长度离散扩散模型，在去噪中联合学习图的大小、片段身份与片段间连接，再用附着位点预测器和化合价感知装配器生成原子级分子，在千万级生成量下兼顾化学合法性与唯一性。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「节点插入/删除 + 尺寸与连接联合建模」的可变长度离散扩散机制，可能为 LVR 中可变长度 latent 状态的生成与长度泛化提供借鉴线索，是否可迁移需人工核查。
